segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about eating food and certain foods that people don't eat.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是人们不吃的食物和某些食物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So today we have special diets.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们有特殊的饮食。

segments.en: We're going to talk all about being a vegetarian or a vegan and we're going to explain all these words when we come back.
segments.zh: 我们将谈论所有关于素食主义者或素食主义者的讨论，当我们回来时，我们将解释所有这些词。

segments.en: So now let's just listen to the dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们听对话。

segments.en: Hey, Julie.
segments.zh: 嘿，朱莉。

segments.en: Do you want to go grab something to eat?
segments.zh: 你想去拿点吃的吗？

segments.en: Sure.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: What do you feel like having?
segments.zh: 你想吃什么？

segments.en: I really feel like having a big juicy steak.
segments.zh: 我真的很想吃一块多汁的牛排。

segments.en: Oh, okay.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧。

segments.en: I don't eat meat, but that's fine.
segments.zh: 我不吃肉，但没关系。

segments.en: I'm sure wherever we're going, they will have other options, right?
segments.zh: 我敢肯定，无论我们去哪里，他们都会有其他选择，对吧？

segments.en: I didn't know you were a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 我不知道你是素食主义者。

segments.en: I'm not.
segments.zh: 我不是。

segments.en: I'm a vegan.
segments.zh: 我是严格素食者。

segments.en: A what?
segments.zh: 什么东西？

segments.en: A vegan.
segments.zh: 严格素食者。

segments.en: I don't eat or use any animal-based products.
segments.zh: 我不吃、也不使用任何动物来源的产品。

segments.en: I don't wear leather, eat eggs, drink milk or anything that comes from an animal.
segments.zh: 我不穿皮革制品，不吃鸡蛋、不喝奶，也不用任何来自动物的东西。

segments.en: I used to be a pescatarian before, which basically means you don't eat meat, but still have fish and seafood.
segments.zh: 我以前是鱼素食者，也就是不吃其他肉类，但仍然吃鱼和海鲜。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: That's interesting.
segments.zh: 真有意思。

segments.en: It must be tough.
segments.zh: 那一定很难。

segments.en: It's a bit difficult to find vegetarian-friendly restaurants sometimes, but since more and more people are vegetarians or vegans nowadays, it's getting a bit less difficult.
segments.zh: 有时候确实不容易找到适合素食者的餐厅，不过现在吃素或严格纯素的人越来越多，找餐厅也渐渐容易些了。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now probably a lot of you have an idea of what it means to be a vegetarian, but let's take a look at that word and many more on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在你们中的很多人可能已经知道成为素食主义者意味着什么，但让我们来看看这个词以及更多关于语言外卖的信息。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So a vegetarian is a noun.
segments.zh: 所以素食主义者是名词。

segments.en: I am a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 我是素食主义者。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Vegetarian is a noun.
segments.zh: 素食是名词。

segments.en: It's a person.
segments.zh: 这是一个人。

segments.en: You say I am a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 你说我是素食主义者。

segments.en: He is a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 他是一个素食主义者。

segments.en: And in this case, a vegetarian person does not eat meat.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，素食者不吃肉。

segments.en: So no chicken, no beef, none of that stuff.
segments.zh: 所以没有鸡肉，没有牛肉，没有那些东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as you can see, it has the prefix veget, like vegetable.
segments.zh: 正如你所看到的，它有前缀蔬菜，就像蔬菜一样。

segments.en: So that's what they eat.
segments.zh: 所以这就是他们吃的。

segments.en: They just eat vegetables.
segments.zh: 他们只吃蔬菜。

segments.en: And it's a little bit hard to say what all vegetarians do or don't eat because some people have different rules.
segments.zh: 很难说所有素食者吃什么或不吃什么，因为有些人有不同的规则。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Some people eat eggs, some people don't.
segments.zh: 有些人吃鸡蛋，有些人不吃。

segments.en: But there is something that is a little bit different from a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 但有些东西与素食者有些不同。

segments.en: It's called a vegan and this person has many, many rules about what he can or cannot eat.
segments.zh: 它被称为素食主义者，这个人有很多很多关于他可以吃什么或不能吃什么的规则。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So a vegetarian basically does not eat meat.
segments.zh: 所以素食者基本上不吃肉。

segments.en: A vegan, as we saw in our dialogue, doesn't wear leather, for example, doesn't wear leather shoes or a jacket or use or eat anything that comes from an animal.
segments.zh: 正如我们在对话中看到的那样，素食主义者不穿皮革，不穿皮鞋或夹克，也不穿或吃来自动物的任何东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: No eggs, right?
segments.zh: 没有鸡蛋吧？

segments.en: No foods that might have any animal products in them.
segments.zh: 没有可能含有任何动物产品的食物。

segments.en: So vegans often try to find foods at the grocery store that come from natural products that are not animal based.
segments.zh: 因此，素食主义者经常试图在杂货店寻找来自非动物性天然产品的食品。

segments.en: And so there has to be a symbol on the back of the box or the jar that says that it's vegan.
segments.zh: 因此，盒子背面或罐子上必须有一个符号，上面写着它是素食主义者。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in that case, they don't drink milk, they don't eat eggs, nothing that you can think of that comes from an animal.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，他们不喝牛奶，他们不吃鸡蛋，你能想到的任何东西都来自动物。

segments.en: But on the other hand, this person used to be a pescatarian.
segments.zh: 但另一方面，这个人曾经是一个兽人。

segments.en: So this is another type of person that has a special diet, very much like a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 所以这是另一种有特殊饮食的人，非常像素食主义者。

segments.en: A pescatarian is a person who is a vegetarian but who also eats fish.
segments.zh: Pescatarian 是一个素食主义者，但也吃鱼的人。

segments.en: And so maybe I'm a pescatarian because I don't consider fish to be animals.
segments.zh: 所以也许我是一个兽人，因为我不认为鱼是动物。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I don't eat lamb, I don't eat chicken, but I do eat fish.
segments.zh: 所以我不吃羊肉，我不吃鸡肉，但我吃鱼。

segments.en: I'm a pescatarian.
segments.zh: 我是一个兽人。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a vegetarian does not eat fish or any type of meat, the same as a vegan, but a pescatarian does eat maybe shrimp and fish and any type of animal from the sea.
segments.zh: 所以素食者不吃鱼或任何类型的肉，就像素食主义者一样，但鱼类确实吃虾和鱼以及任何类型的海洋动物。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well, that brings us up to our next word.
segments.zh: 好吧，这让我们走到了下一个词。

segments.en: A pescatarian will eat seafood.
segments.zh: 佩斯卡塔尔人会吃海鲜。

segments.en: Seafood is a word we use to describe animals that come from the sea.
segments.zh: 海鲜是我们用来描述来自海的动物的词。

segments.en: So not just fish.
segments.zh: 所以不只是鱼。

segments.en: So like you said, shrimp and lobster.
segments.zh: 所以就像你说的，虾和龙虾。

segments.en: You could even think of really delicious food like a seafood pasta or a seafood salad, octopus, things like that.
segments.zh: 你甚至可以想到真正美味的食物，比如海鲜意大利面或海鲜沙拉、章鱼之类的东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you got clams, you have oysters, anything that comes from the sea is considered seafood.
segments.zh: 所以你有蛤蜊，你有牡蛎，任何来自大海的东西都被认为是海鲜。

segments.en: Right?
segments.zh: 对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And our last word in language takeaway is an adjective.
segments.zh: 我们在语言外卖中的最后一个词是形容词。

segments.en: We heard at the end of the dialogue, our character said, it must be tough.
segments.zh: 我们在对话结束时听说，我们的角色说，一定很艰难。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That's an interesting word because in English it has a few different meanings, but what was the meaning of the word tough in today's dialogue?
segments.zh: 这是一个有趣的词，因为在英语中它有一些不同的含义，但是在今天的对话中这个词的意思是什么意思？

segments.en: In today's dialogue, when the person said it must be tough, it's basically saying it must be difficult.
segments.zh: 在今天的对话中，当这个人说它一定很艰难时，基本上是说它一定很困难。

segments.en: It must be difficult to be a vegetarian.
segments.zh: 成为素食主义者一定很困难。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a hard situation.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个艰难的情况。

segments.en: You could also say, oh man, this homework is really tough.
segments.zh: 你也可以说，哦，伙计，这个作业真的很艰难。

segments.en: That means it's hard.
segments.zh: 这意味着它很难。

segments.en: It's difficult.
segments.zh: 这很难。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So we've taken a look at a lot of key words there.
segments.zh: 所以我们在那里看了很多关键词。

segments.en: Sure.

segments.en: What do you feel like having?

segments.en: I really feel like having a big juicy steak.

segments.en: Oh, okay.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧。

segments.en: I don't eat meat, but that's fine.

segments.en: Now we've prepared three phrases for you.
segments.zh: 现在我们为您准备了三个短语。

segments.en: Let's take a look at those now on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在来看看“流利表达”里的这些内容。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So there's a very interesting and very, very common phrase at the beginning of today's dialogue that we use all the time in English.
segments.zh: 因此，在今天的对话开始时，有一个非常有趣且非常常见的短语，我们一直用英语使用。

segments.en: This is to grab something to eat.
segments.zh: 这是为了吃点东西。

segments.en: The character says, hey Julie, you want to go grab something to eat?
segments.zh: 角色说，嘿，朱莉，你想去吃点吃的吗？

segments.en: So taking that as a phrase, we are inviting someone to go eat something.
segments.zh: 所以把它当作一个短语，我们邀请有人去吃东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I could say, hey, do you want to go eat something?
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，嘿，你想去吃点东西吗？

segments.en: Or I could say, hey, do you want to go grab something to eat?
segments.zh: 或者我可以说，嘿，你想去吃点东西吗？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And the verb grab is to take or to hold in your hand.
segments.zh: 动词 grab 是拿或握在你的手中。

segments.en: So you want to go grab something to eat is basically that.
segments.zh: 所以你想去吃点东西基本上就是这样。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: But don't be confused because grabbing normally means holding with your hand, but to grab something to eat generally just means, hey, would you like to go eat something with me?
segments.zh: 但不要感到困惑，因为抓握通常意味着用手握住，但抓住一些东西通常意味着，嘿，你想和我一起去吃点东西吗？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And of course we want to go grab something to eat and the guy says, I really feel like having a big juicy steak.
segments.zh: 当然，我们想去吃点东西，那家伙说，我真的很想吃一块多汁的牛排。

segments.en: So we feel like having a steak.
segments.zh: 所以我们想吃牛排。

segments.en: This is very spoken English.
segments.zh: 这是非常口头的英语。

segments.en: So remember when you're talking to your friends, this is okay, but maybe if you're writing something it's not as good.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，当您与朋友交谈时，这没关系，但也许如果您正在写东西，那就没有那么好了。

segments.en: But I feel like a steak means I want to eat a steak.
segments.zh: 但我觉得牛排意味着我想吃牛排。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you're saying you are a steak.
segments.zh: 所以你说你是牛排。

segments.en: No, I don't feel like a steak, like a piece of meat, but I do want to eat a piece of, I do want to eat a steak.
segments.zh: 不，我不觉得像牛排，像一块肉，但我确实想吃一块，我确实想吃牛排。

segments.en: And so I feel like having, or I feel like a steak.
segments.zh: 所以我想拥有，或者我觉得自己像牛排。

segments.en: These are both acceptable in spoken English.
segments.zh: 这些在英语口语中都是可以接受的。

segments.en: So you basically feel like doing something or you feel like eating something.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上想做某事或你想吃点东西。

segments.en: For example, if we're going to have dinner, you can say, I feel like having Italian food.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我们要吃晚饭，你可以说，我想吃意大利菜。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I don't feel like having Italian food tonight.
segments.zh: 我今晚不想吃意大利菜。

segments.en: I feel like having Mexican food.
segments.zh: 我想吃墨西哥菜。

segments.en: And I also feel like watching a movie.
segments.zh: 我也想看电影。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So great ways of using feel like, and then a verb like having or watching a movie.
segments.zh: 如此棒的使用感觉，然后是像拥有或看电影这样的动词。

segments.en: Now getting back to the vegetarian, the vegan aspect of our dialogue, we saw that the girl explained how she doesn't eat or use any animal based products.
segments.zh: 现在回到素食主义者，我们对话的素食主义者方面，我们看到这个女孩解释了她如何不吃或使用任何动物产品。

segments.en: So these three words, animal based products.
segments.zh: 所以这三个词，动物产品。

segments.en: So product is basically anything that will be sold or bought.
segments.zh: 所以产品基本上是任何将要出售或购买的东西。

segments.en: Animal based is a way to describe a product.
segments.zh: 基于动物的是描述产品的一种方式。

segments.en: So some products have animal products in them.
segments.zh: 所以有些产品里面有动物产品。

segments.en: So for example, my shoes are an animal based product because they are leather and leather comes from cows, which are animals.
segments.zh: 例如，我的鞋子是一种动物产品，因为它们是皮革的，皮革来自牛，它们是动物。

segments.en: So you're basically saying that they have something from an animal.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上是说他们有动物的东西。

segments.en: They are made up of something that comes from an animal like leather shoes.
segments.zh: 它们由动物如皮鞋制成的东西组成。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And it's not just shoes.
segments.zh: 这不仅仅是鞋子。

segments.en: It's also shampoo or some of the foods that you eat like in jars and cans.
segments.zh: 它也是洗发水或你吃的一些食物，比如罐子和罐头。

segments.en: It's important if you're a vegan to look on the side of the can or the side of the box and see is this an animal based product?
segments.zh: 如果您是素食主义者，可以从罐子的侧面或盒子的侧面看，看看这是一种动物产品吗？

segments.en: Are there animal products in this?

segments.en: Right.

segments.en: Okay.

segments.zh: 我不穿皮革制品，不吃鸡蛋、不喝奶，也不用任何来自动物的东西。

segments.en: I used to be a pescatarian before, which basically means you don't eat meat, but still have fish and seafood.
segments.zh: 我以前是鱼素食者，也就是不吃其他肉类，但仍然吃鱼和海鲜。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: That's interesting.
segments.zh: 真有意思。

segments.en: It must be tough.
segments.zh: 那一定很难。

segments.en: It's a bit difficult to find vegetarian friendly restaurants sometimes, but since more and more people are vegetarians or vegans nowadays, it's getting a bit less difficult.
segments.zh: 有时很难找到适合素食的餐厅，但由于现在越来越多的人是素食者或素食主义者，因此变得不那么困难了。

segments.en: All right, so talking about vegan vegetarians, pescatarians, it seems like these diets or these lifestyles are more and more popular, but as we saw in the dialogue, it can be a little bit difficult, especially maybe in countries where it's not so popular to have these diets.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以说到素食主义者、pescatarians 似乎这些饮食或这些生活方式越来越受欢迎，但正如我们在对话中看到的那样，这可能有点困难，尤其是在那些不那么受欢迎的国家。

segments.en: Definitely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: I think that in places where you can find vegan and vegetarian products very easily, being a vegetarian becomes much more easy because you have more options.
segments.zh: 我认为在你可以很容易找到素食和素食产品的地方，成为素食主义者变得更加容易，因为你有更多的选择。

segments.en: But if you're living in a country where it's very hard to eat a meal without having meat, then you might just eat potatoes every day and that will get very, very difficult and very boring.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您生活在一个不吃肉就很难吃饭的国家，那么您可能每天都只吃土豆，这将变得非常、非常非常困难和非常无聊。

segments.en: Well, that's one of the main arguments or the main concerns with people is that even though you can argue that you can get all the vitamins or many of the vitamins and minerals from nuts and from vegetables, it's still not healthy to completely exclude from your diet maybe sources of proteins like meat or eggs or dairy products.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是主要的论点或与人们的主要关注点之一是，即使您可以从坚果和蔬菜中获得所有维生素或许多维生素和矿物质，但完全排除饮食中的蛋白质或鸡蛋等蛋白质仍然是不健康的 乳制品。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so in America, for example, it's very easy to find supplements.
segments.zh: 例如，在美国，很容易找到补充剂。

segments.en: You can take vitamins like calcium and you can have pills that will give you some protein and you can find all sorts of exotic vegetables that will help you supplement your diet.
segments.zh: 你可以服用维生素，比如钙，你可以吃一些可以给你一些蛋白质的药丸，你可以找到各种各样的异国蔬菜，这些蔬菜可以帮助你补充你的饮食。

segments.en: But in a place like China, for example, I think it can be a lot harder to find those products and to find those supplements.
segments.zh: 但在像中国这样的地方，我认为找到这些产品并找到这些补充剂可能会困难得多。

segments.en: And so being a vegan especially or a vegetarian poses a lot more challenges.
segments.zh: 因此，尤其是素食主义者或素食主义者，会带来更多挑战。

segments.en: Especially I think with what you mentioned that products are usually labeled where they tell you if they have any animal based products in there.
segments.zh: 尤其是我认为您提到的产品通常被贴上标签，告诉您他们是否有任何动物性产品。

segments.en: Whereas in other countries, it's probably not labeled and it's a little bit, even things like getting the fat free things are a little bit more difficult in other countries like for example, China.
segments.zh: 而在其他国家，它可能没有贴上标签，而且有点像中国，甚至在其他国家获得无脂肪的东西也有些困难。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we would like to know, are there many vegans or vegetarians in your country?
segments.zh: 所以我们想知道，你们国家有很多素食主义者或素食主义者吗？

segments.en: And if there are, do you think it's hard for them to buy food?
segments.zh: 如果有的话，你认为他们很难买食物吗？

segments.en: Why or why not?
segments.zh: 为什么或为什么不呢？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Take care.
segments.zh: 保重。
